CHN.funFact: China is wide enough for about five time zones, yet the entire country officially runs on one clock: Beijing Time (UTC+8).

JPN.funFact: A 2023 recount by Japan's mapping authority found 14,125 islands, more than double the 6,852 counted in 1987.

PAK.funFact: Pakistan is home to five of the world's 14 mountains above 8,000 m, including K2, the second highest peak on Earth.

USA.funFact: All 12 people who have walked on the Moon (1969-1972, NASA's Apollo program) were Americans.

IND.funFact: India has the world's largest postal network, with 164,999 post offices as of March 2025, about 90% of them in rural areas.

AUS.funFact: Australia is nearly 4,000 km wide from east to west, wider than the Moon, which is about 3,475 km across.

GRC.funFact: No point in Greece is more than about 137 km (85 miles) away from water.

ITA.funFact: Italy completely surrounds two independent countries: Vatican City and San Marino.
